headline: Global Markets Rise as Oil Prices Drop 6% on US-Iran Negotiation Hopes
summary: European and US stock markets gained as Brent crude oil prices fell by 6%. Investors reacted positively to reports of potential progress in US-Iran negotiations, which helped ease energy cost concerns.
why: Oil is a primary input for many industries; a significant drop in prices typically reduces inflationary pressures and lowers operating costs for energy-intensive sectors, often boosting broader equity market sentiment.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: The input explicitly states a 6% drop in Brent crude prices.
